[[File:Tyber_vs._Adepts.jpg|thumb|266px]]The '''Force Adepts''', also known as '''Dark Side Adepts''', were an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] group of mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They wielded red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and wore black and red-hued robes. The most powerful members of this group were able to teleport.

==History==
A group of Imperial Force Adepts were deployed on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] along with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] when [[Tyber Zann]], [[Urai Fen]] and [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] tried to [[Ground Battle on Bespin|escape]] from the floating city with a store of [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas.

Two others groups of those [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]] were stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The first group with their leader, a Master Force Adept, faced Tyber Zann as he [[Raid on the Imperial Archive|raided]] [[Imperial Archives (museum)/Legends|Sidious's Imperial Museum]]. The second group fought [[Silri]] and [[Cuddles|her rancor]] as well as Urai Fen. All of these groups were defeated however.
